purpose: Primary-source metadata and attribution ledger for the standard algebraic, matroid, lattice-transform, and exact-determinant components used in the research article.
scope: These citations attribute established components. They do not establish priority for the particular application to positive unit peeling, nor certify a quasi-polynomial unknot-recognition algorithm.

references.title: Determinantal Sieving
references.access_notes: Journal page, journal BibTeX export and author-preprint full HTML opened. Journal publication date is 2 October 2025.

references.metadata_notes: The journal BibTeX export identifies volume 4 and article 21. Both listed journal URLs are publisher records for the same article.
